# Phase One — Chessed: Make the Product Economy Real

From the Awtsmoos every capability is recreated anew; Awtsmoos.com should reveal one trustworthy product graph where value, ownership, use, and discovery agree.

## Boundless Goal
- Every canonical product participates in one server-owned capability system.
- Every paid capability has truthful cost, fulfillment, entitlement semantics, support identity, analytics identity, and tests.
- Credits buy real outcomes or permanent optional delight; basic free usefulness stays intact.
- Marketplace, Wallet, product shell, SEO, docs, tests, and future agents consume the same product truth.
- Product pages become crawlable, marketable, mobile-first, accessible, fast, and resilient.

## Seven Parallel Rivers
1. Universal permanent cosmetic entitlement as the first ethical catalog-wide credit sink.
2. Capability quote/read API so browser code never authors cost.
3. Shared shell ownership state and theme application.
4. Capability/readiness tests across all 80 products.
5. Crawlable marketplace inventory and structured metadata.
6. Search/recents/favorites/workflow graph from canonical product truth.
7. Commerce observability, reconciliation, stale-reservation cleanup, and abuse signals.
